# HeroUI v3 Documentation

> A set of beautiful, customizable React and React Native components that stay maintained and up to date.

HeroUI v3 is an open-source UI component library for building modern web and mobile applications. Built on [Tailwind CSS v4](https://tailwindcss.com/) and [React Aria Components](https://react-spectrum.adobe.com/react-aria/), HeroUI provides accessible, customizable components with smooth animations and polished details.

**Key Features:**

- Beautiful by default - Professional look out of the box, no extra styling needed
- Accessible - Built with accessibility in mind, following WAI-ARIA guidelines
- Flexible - Each component is made of customizable parts
- Developer-friendly - Fully typed APIs, predictable patterns, and excellent autocompletion
- Maintained - Regular updates, bug fixes, and new features

**Technology Stack:**

- React 19+ for web components
- React Native for mobile components
- Tailwind CSS v4 for styling
- TypeScript for type safety

## Available Platforms

- **React (Web)**: [/react/llms.txt](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/react/llms.txt) - React component library for web applications
- **React Native**: [/native/llms.txt](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/native/llms.txt) - React Native component library for mobile applications

## Documentation Index

### React

- [Quick Navigation](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components): Browse Hero UI 3 React components and jump directly to the building block you need.
- [ButtonGroup](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/button-group): Group related buttons together with consistent styling and spacing
- [Button](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/button): A clickable button component with multiple variants and states
- [CloseButton](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/close-button): Button component for closing dialogs, modals, or dismissing content
- [ToggleButtonGroup](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/toggle-button-group): Groups multiple ToggleButtons into a unified control, allowing users to select one or multiple options.
- [ToggleButton](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/toggle-button): An interactive toggle control for on/off or selected/unselected states
- [Dropdown](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/dropdown): A dropdown displays a list of actions or options that a user can choose
- [ListBox](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/list-box): A listbox displays a list of options and allows a user to select one or more of them
- [TagGroup](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/tag-group): A focusable list of tags with support for keyboard navigation, selection, and removal
- [ColorArea](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/color-area): A 2D color picker that allows users to select colors from a gradient area
- [ColorField](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/color-field): Color input field with labels, descriptions, and validation built on React Aria ColorField
- [ColorPicker](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/color-picker): A composable color picker that synchronizes color value between multiple color components
- [ColorSlider](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/color-slider): A color slider allows users to adjust an individual channel of a color value
- [ColorSwatchPicker](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/color-swatch-picker): A list of color swatches that allows users to select a color from a predefined palette.
- [ColorSwatch](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/color-swatch): A visual preview of a color value with accessibility support
- [Slider](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/slider): A slider allows a user to select one or more values within a range
- [Switch](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/switch): A toggle switch component for boolean states
- [Badge](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/badge): Displays a small indicator positioned relative to another element, commonly used for notification counts, status dots, and labels
- [Chip](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/chip): Small informational badges for displaying labels, statuses, and categories
- [Table](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/table): Tables display structured data in rows and columns with support for sorting, selection, column resizing, and infinite scrolling.
- [Calendar](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/calendar): Composable date picker with month grid, navigation, and year picker support built on React Aria Calendar
- [DateField](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/date-field): Date input field with labels, descriptions, and validation built on React Aria DateField
- [DatePicker](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/date-picker): Composable date picker built on React Aria DatePicker with DateField and Calendar composition
- [DateRangePicker](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/date-range-picker): Composable date range picker built on React Aria DateRangePicker with DateField and RangeCalendar composition
- [RangeCalendar](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/range-calendar): Composable date range picker with month grid, navigation, and year picker support built on React Aria RangeCalendar
- [TimeField](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/time-field): Time input field with labels, descriptions, and validation built on React Aria TimeField
- [Alert](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/alert): Display important messages and notifications to users with status indicators
- [Meter](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/meter): A meter represents a quantity within a known range, or a fractional value.
- [ProgressBar](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/progress-bar): A progress bar shows either determinate or indeterminate progress of an operation over time.
- [ProgressCircle](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/progress-circle): A circular progress indicator that shows determinate or indeterminate progress.
- [Skeleton](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/skeleton): Skeleton is a placeholder to show a loading state and the expected shape of a component.
- [Spinner](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/spinner): A loading indicator component to show pending states
- [CheckboxGroup](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/checkbox-group): A checkbox group component for managing multiple checkbox selections
- [Checkbox](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/checkbox): Checkboxes allow users to select multiple items from a list of individual items, or to mark one individual item as selected.
- [Description](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/description): Provides supplementary text for form fields and other components
- [ErrorMessage](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/error-message): A low-level error message component for displaying errors
- [FieldError](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/field-error): Displays validation error messages for form fields
- [Fieldset](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/fieldset): Group related form controls with legends, descriptions, and actions
- [Form](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/form): Wrapper component for form validation and submission handling
- [InputGroup](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/input-group): Group related input controls with prefix and suffix elements for enhanced form fields
- [InputOTP](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/input-otp): A one-time password input component for verification codes and secure authentication
- [Input](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/input): Primitive single-line text input component that accepts standard HTML attributes
- [Label](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/label): Renders an accessible label associated with form controls
- [NumberField](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/number-field): Number input fields with increment/decrement buttons, validation, and internationalized formatting
- [RadioGroup](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/radio-group): Radio group for selecting a single option from a list
- [SearchField](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/search-field): Search input field with clear button and search icon
- [TextArea](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/text-area): Primitive multiline text input component that accepts standard HTML attributes
- [TextField](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/text-field): Composition-friendly text fields with labels, descriptions, and inline validation
- [Card](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/card): Flexible container component for grouping related content and actions
- [Separator](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/separator): Visually divide content sections
- [Surface](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/surface): Container component that provides surface-level styling and context for child components
- [Toolbar](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/toolbar): A container for interactive controls with arrow key navigation.
- [Avatar](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/avatar): Display user profile images with customizable fallback content
- [Accordion](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/accordion): A collapsible content panel for organizing information in a compact space
- [Breadcrumbs](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/breadcrumbs): Navigation breadcrumbs showing the current page's location within a hierarchy
- [DisclosureGroup](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/disclosure-group): Container that manages multiple Disclosure items with coordinated expanded states
- [Disclosure](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/disclosure): A disclosure is a collapsible section with a header containing a heading and a trigger button, and a panel that wraps the content.
- [Link](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/link): A styled anchor component for navigation with built-in icon support
- [Pagination](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/pagination): Page navigation with composable page links, previous/next buttons, and ellipsis indicators
- [Tabs](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/tabs): Tabs organize content into multiple sections and allow users to navigate between them.
- [AlertDialog](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/alert-dialog): Modal dialog for critical confirmations requiring user attention and explicit action
- [Drawer](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/drawer): Slide-out panel for supplementary content and actions
- [Modal](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/modal): Dialog overlay for focused user interactions and important content
- [Popover](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/popover): Displays rich content in a portal triggered by a button or any custom element
- [Toast](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/toast): Display temporary notifications and messages to users with automatic dismissal and customizable placement
- [Tooltip](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/tooltip): Displays informative text when users hover over or focus on an element
- [Autocomplete](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/autocomplete): An autocomplete combines a select with filtering, allowing users to search and select from a list of options
- [ComboBox](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/combo-box): A combo box combines a text input with a listbox, allowing users to filter a list of options to items matching a query
- [Select](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/select): A select displays a collapsible list of options and allows a user to select one of them
- [Kbd](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/kbd): Display keyboard shortcuts and key combinations
- [Typography](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/typography): A semantic typography primitive for headings, body copy, and inline code built on React Aria Components Text.
- [ScrollShadow](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/react/components/scroll-shadow): Apply visual shadows to indicate scrollable content overflow with automatic detection of scroll position.
- [快速导航](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components): 浏览 Hero UI 3 的 React 组件，并快速跳转到你需要的组件。
- [ButtonGroup 按钮组](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/button-group): 将相关按钮组合在一起，并提供一致的样式与间距。
- [Button 按钮](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/button): 可点击的按钮组件，支持多种变体与状态。
- [CloseButton 关闭按钮](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/close-button): 用于关闭对话框、模态框或收起内容的按钮组件。
- [ToggleButtonGroup 切换按钮组](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/toggle-button-group): 将多个 ToggleButton 组合为统一控件，允许用户选择单个或多个选项。
- [ToggleButton 切换按钮](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/toggle-button): 用于在开启/关闭或已选中/未选中状态之间切换的交互式切换控件。
- [Dropdown 下拉菜单](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/dropdown): 下拉菜单展示一组可供用户选择的操作或选项。
- [ListBox 列表框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/list-box): 列表框展示一组选项，并允许用户选择一个或多个。
- [TagGroup 标签组](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/tag-group): 可聚焦的标签列表，支持键盘导航、选择与移除。

- [ColorField 颜色输入框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/color-field): 基于 React Aria ColorField 的颜色输入字段，包含标签、说明与校验能力。
- [ColorPicker 颜色选择器](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/color-picker): 可组合的 ColorPicker，在多个颜色组件之间同步颜色值。
- [ColorSlider 颜色滑块](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/color-slider): ColorSlider 允许用户调整颜色值的单个通道。
- [ColorSwatchPicker 颜色色块选择器](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/color-swatch-picker): 允许用户从预置调色板中选择颜色的 swatch 列表。
- [ColorSwatch 颜色色块](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/color-swatch): 颜色值的视觉预览，并提供无障碍支持。
- [Slider 滑块](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/slider): Slider 允许用户在范围内选择一个或多个值。
- [Switch 开关](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/switch): 用于布尔状态的开关组件。
- [Badge 徽标](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/badge): 展示相对其他元素定位的小型指示器，常用于未读数、状态点与标签等场景。
- [Chip 标签](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/chip): 用于展示标签、状态与分类等信息的小型徽标。
- [Table 表格](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/table): 表格以行和列展示结构化数据，支持排序、选择、列宽调整与无限滚动。

- [DateField 日期字段](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/date-field): 基于 React Aria DateField 的日期输入字段，包含标签、说明与校验。
- [DatePicker 日期选择器](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/date-picker): 可组合的日期选择器，基于 React Aria DatePicker，通过 DateField 与 Calendar 组合实现。
- [DateRangePicker 日期范围选择器](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/date-range-picker): 基于 React Aria DateRangePicker 的可组合日期范围选择器，由 DateField 与 RangeCalendar 组合而成。
- [RangeCalendar 范围日历](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/range-calendar): 基于 React Aria RangeCalendar 的可组合日期范围选择器，包含月份网格、导航与年份选择支持。
- [TimeField 时间字段](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/time-field): 基于 React Aria TimeField 的时间输入字段，包含标签、说明与校验。
- [Alert 警告](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/alert): 向用户展示重要消息与通知，并提供状态指示。
- [Meter 计量条](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/meter): Meter 表示已知范围内的数量，或一个比例值。
- [ProgressBar 进度条](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/progress-bar): 进度条用于展示某项操作随时间变化的确定或不确定进度。
- [ProgressCircle 环形进度条](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/progress-circle): 环形进度指示器，用于展示确定或不确定的进度。
- [Skeleton 骨架屏](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/skeleton): Skeleton 用于展示加载状态，并预览组件的预期形状。
- [Spinner 加载指示器](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/spinner): 用于展示等待或处理中状态的加载指示组件。
- [CheckboxGroup 复选框组](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/checkbox-group): 用于管理多项复选框选择的 CheckboxGroup 组件。
- [Checkbox 复选框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/checkbox): 复选框允许用户从多个独立选项中选择多项，或将单个独立选项标记为已选。
- [Description 描述](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/description): 为表单字段及其他组件提供补充说明文字。
- [ErrorMessage 错误信息](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/error-message): 用于展示错误信息的底层组件。
- [FieldError 字段错误](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/field-error): 用于展示表单字段的校验错误信息。
- [Fieldset 字段集](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/fieldset): 使用 legend、description 与操作区对相关表单控件进行分组。
- [Form 表单](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/form): 用于表单校验与提交处理的包装组件。
- [InputGroup 输入框组](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/input-group): 将相关输入控件与前后缀元素组合，以增强表单字段。
- [InputOTP 一次性密码输入框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/input-otp): 用于验证码与安全认证等场景的一次性密码输入组件。
- [Input 输入框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/input): 单行文本输入原语，可接受标准 HTML 属性。
- [Label 标签](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/label): 渲染与表单控件关联的无障碍标签。
- [NumberField 数字输入框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/number-field): 数字输入字段，包含增减按钮、校验与国际化格式化能力。
- [RadioGroup 单选框组](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/radio-group): 用于从列表中选择单个选项的单选组。
- [SearchField 搜索框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/search-field): 搜索输入字段，包含清除按钮与搜索图标。
- [TextArea 多行文本框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/text-area): 原语级多行文本输入组件，可接受标准 HTML 属性。
- [TextField 文本输入框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/text-field): 便于组合的文本字段，包含标签、说明与内联校验。
- [Card 卡片](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/card): 用于分组相关内容与操作的灵活容器组件。
- [Separator 分隔符](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/separator): 在内容区块之间进行视觉分隔。
- [Surface 表面](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/surface): 提供表面级样式与子组件上下文的容器组件。
- [Toolbar 工具栏](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/toolbar): 用于承载可交互控件的容器，并支持方向键导航。
- [Avatar 头像](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/avatar): 展示用户头像图片，并提供可定制的回退内容。
- [Accordion 手风琴](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/accordion): 用于在紧凑空间中组织信息的可折叠内容面板。
- [Breadcrumbs 面包屑](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/breadcrumbs): 面包屑导航，用于展示当前页面在层级结构中的位置。
- [DisclosureGroup 折叠面板组](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/disclosure-group): 管理多个 Disclosure 的容器，用于协调展开状态。
- [Disclosure 折叠面板](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/disclosure): Disclosure 是一种可折叠区域：头部包含标题与触发按钮，面板包裹正文内容。
- [Link 链接](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/link): 用于导航的样式化锚点组件，内置图标支持。
- [Pagination 分页](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/pagination): 分页导航：可组合的页码链接、上一页/下一页按钮与省略号指示器。
- [Tabs 标签页](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/tabs): Tabs 将内容组织为多个区块，并允许用户在它们之间导航。
- [AlertDialog 警告对话框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/alert-dialog): 用于关键确认的模态对话框，需要用户关注并执行明确操作。
- [Drawer 抽屉](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/drawer): 用于补充内容与操作的侧滑面板。
- [Modal 模态框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/modal): 用于聚焦用户交互与重要内容的对话框遮罩层。
- [Popover 弹出框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/popover): 在由按钮或任意自定义元素触发后，于 portal 中展示丰富内容。
- [Toast 轻提示](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/toast): 向用户展示临时通知与消息，支持自动消失与可定制的放置位置。
- [Tooltip 工具提示](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/tooltip): 当用户悬停或聚焦某个元素时，展示提示性文本。
- [Autocomplete 自动完成](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/autocomplete): 自动完成将选择与过滤结合，让用户可以搜索并从选项列表中选择。
- [ComboBox 组合框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/combo-box): 将文本输入与 ListBox 结合，用户可通过输入查询把选项列表过滤为匹配项。
- [Select 选择器](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/select): Select 展示可折叠的选项列表，并允许用户从中选择一项。
- [Kbd 键盘按键](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/kbd): 用于展示键盘快捷键与组合键。
- [Typography 排版](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/typography): 面向标题、正文与行内代码的语义化排版原语，基于 React Aria Components 的 Text 构建。
- [ScrollShadow 滚动阴影](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/react/components/scroll-shadow): 通过阴影提示可滚动溢出内容，并根据滚动位置自动检测显示或隐藏。

### Native

- [All Components](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components): Explore the full list of components available in HeroUI Native. More are on the way.
- [Button](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/button): Interactive component that triggers an action when pressed.
- [CloseButton](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/close-button): Button component for closing dialogs, modals, or dismissing content.
- [LinkButton](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/link-button): A ghost-variant button with no highlight feedback, designed for inline link-style interactions.
- [Menu](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/menu): A floating context menu with positioning, selection groups, and multiple presentation modes.
- [TagGroup](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/tag-group): A compound component for displaying and managing selectable tags with optional removal.
- [Slider](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/slider): A draggable input for selecting a value or range within a bounded interval.
- [Switch](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/switch): A toggle control that allows users to switch between on and off states.
- [Chip](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/chip): Displays a compact element in a capsule shape.
- [Alert](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/alert): Displays important messages and notifications to users with status indicators.
- [SkeletonGroup](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/skeleton-group): Coordinates multiple skeleton loading placeholders with centralized animation control.
- [Skeleton](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/skeleton): Displays a loading placeholder with shimmer or pulse animation effects.
- [Spinner](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/spinner): Displays an animated loading indicator.
- [Checkbox](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/checkbox): A selectable control that allows users to toggle between checked and unchecked states.
- [ControlField](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/control-field): A field component that combines a label, description (or other content), and a control component (Switch or Checkbox) into a single pressable area.
- [Description](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/description): Text component for providing accessible descriptions and helper text for form fields and other UI elements.
- [FieldError](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/field-error): Displays validation error message content with smooth animations.
- [InputGroup](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/input-group): A compound layout component that groups an input with optional prefix and suffix decorators.
- [InputOTP](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/input-otp): Input component for entering one-time passwords (OTP) with individual character slots, animations, and validation support.
- [Input](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/input): A text input component with styled border and background for collecting user input.
- [Label](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/label): Text component for labeling form fields and other UI elements with support for required indicators and validation states.
- [RadioGroup](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/radio-group): A set of radio buttons where only one option can be selected at a time.
- [SearchField](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/search-field): A compound search input for filtering and querying content.
- [Select](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/select): Displays a list of options for the user to pick from — triggered by a button.
- [TextArea](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/text-area): A multiline text input component with styled border and background for collecting longer user input.
- [TextField](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/text-field): A text input component with label, description, and error handling for collecting user input.
- [Card](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/card): Displays a card container with flexible layout sections for structured content.
- [Separator](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/separator): A simple line to separate content visually.
- [Surface](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/surface): Container component that provides elevation and background styling.
- [Avatar](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/avatar): Displays a user avatar with support for images, text initials, or fallback icons.
- [Accordion](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/accordion): A collapsible content panel for organizing information in a compact space
- [ListGroup](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/list-group): A Surface-based container that groups related list items with consistent layout and spacing.
- [Tabs](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/tabs): Organize content into tabbed views with animated transitions and indicators.
- [BottomSheet](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/bottom-sheet): Displays a bottom sheet that slides up from the bottom with animated transitions and swipe-to-dismiss gestures.
- [Dialog](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/dialog): Displays a modal overlay with animated transitions and gesture-based dismissal.
- [Popover](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/popover): Displays a floating content panel anchored to a trigger element with placement and alignment options.
- [Toast](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/toast): Displays temporary notification messages that appear at the top or bottom of the screen.
- [Typography](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/text): Primitive typography component for rendering styled text with semantic type variants.
- [PressableFeedback](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/pressable-feedback): Container component that provides visual feedback for press interactions with automatic scale animation.
- [ScrollShadow](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/en/docs/native/components/scroll-shadow): Adds dynamic gradient shadows to scrollable content based on scroll position and overflow.
- [所有组件](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components): 浏览 HeroUI Native 提供的全部组件；更多组件将陆续推出。
- [Button 按钮](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/button): 按下时触发操作的交互组件。
- [CloseButton 关闭按钮](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/close-button): 用于关闭对话框、模态框或收起内容的按钮组件。
- [LinkButton 链接按钮](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/link-button): 幽灵样式按钮，无高亮按压反馈，适合行内链接式交互。
- [Menu 菜单](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/menu): 浮动上下文菜单，支持定位、选择分组与多种呈现方式。
- [TagGroup 标签组](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/tag-group): 用于展示与管理可选标签的复合组件，支持可选移除。
- [Slider 滑块](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/slider): 在有限区间内通过拖拽选择单个值或区间的输入控件。
- [Switch 开关](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/switch): 在开与关两种状态之间切换的拨动控件。
- [Chip 标签](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/chip): 以胶囊形态展示的小型元素。
- [Alert 警告](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/alert): 向用户展示重要消息与通知，并带有状态指示。
- [SkeletonGroup 骨架屏组](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/skeleton-group): 协调多个骨架屏占位，并提供统一的动画与加载态控制。
- [Skeleton 骨架屏](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/skeleton): 展示加载占位，支持微光（shimmer）或脉冲（pulse）等动画效果。
- [Spinner 加载指示器](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/spinner): 展示旋转加载动画。
- [Checkbox 复选框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/checkbox): 可在选中与未选中之间切换的可选控件。
- [ControlField 控件字段](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/control-field): 将标签、说明（或其他内容）与控件（Switch 或 Checkbox）组合为单一可按压区域的字段组件。
- [Description 描述](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/description): 用于为表单字段等提供无障碍说明与辅助文案的文本组件。
- [FieldError 字段错误](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/field-error): 展示校验错误信息，并带有平滑动画。
- [InputGroup 输入框组](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/input-group): 复合布局组件，将输入框与可选的前后缀装饰组合在一起。
- [InputOTP 一次性密码输入框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/input-otp): 用于输入一次性验证码（OTP）的输入组件，支持分格、动画与校验。
- [Input 输入框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/input): 单行文本输入，带样式边框与背景，用于收集用户输入。
- [Label 标签](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/label): 用于标注表单字段等 UI 的文本组件，支持必填标记与校验状态。
- [RadioGroup 单选框组](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/radio-group): 单选按钮组，同一时间只能选中一个选项。
- [SearchField 搜索框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/search-field): 用于筛选与查询的复合搜索输入框。
- [Select 选择器](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/select): 通过按钮触发，展示可选列表供用户选择。
- [TextArea 多行文本框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/text-area): 多行文本输入，带样式边框与背景，用于收集较长内容。
- [TextField 文本输入框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/text-field): 带标签、说明与错误处理的文本输入，用于收集用户输入。
- [Card 卡片](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/card): 卡片容器，提供灵活分区以结构化展示内容。
- [Separator 分隔符](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/separator): 用于在视觉上分隔内容的简单线条。
- [Surface 表面](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/surface): 提供层级与背景样式的容器组件。
- [Avatar 头像](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/avatar): 展示用户头像，支持图片、文字首字母或回退图标。
- [Accordion 手风琴](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/accordion): 可折叠内容面板，在紧凑空间内组织信息
- [ListGroup 列表组](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/list-group): 基于 Surface 的容器，用于分组展示列表项并保持一致的布局与间距。
- [Tabs 标签页](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/tabs): 使用选项卡视图组织内容，支持动画过渡与指示器。
- [BottomSheet 底部弹层](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/bottom-sheet): 自底部滑入的底部表单，带动画与下滑关闭手势。
- [Dialog 对话框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/dialog): 模态浮层，带动画过渡并支持手势关闭。
- [Popover 弹出框](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/popover): 锚定在触发器上的浮动内容面板，支持方位与对齐选项。
- [Toast 轻提示](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/toast): 在屏幕顶部或底部展示的临时通知消息。
- [Typography 文本](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/text): 用于渲染带语义类型变体的样式化文本的排版基元组件。
- [PressableFeedback 按压反馈](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/pressable-feedback): 为按压交互提供视觉反馈的容器组件，内置缩放动画。
- [ScrollShadow 滚动阴影](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/components/scroll-shadow): 根据滚动位置与溢出情况，为可滚动内容添加动态渐变边缘阴影。
- [介绍](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/getting-started): 开源 React Native UI 组件库，用于构建美观且易于访问的移动界面。
- [Beta 10](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/releases/beta-10): Bottom Sheet 组件、PressableFeedback 重构、动画 API 的 State 扩展、use-theme-color 多色选取与问题修复
- [Beta 11](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/releases/beta-11): Bottom Sheet 关闭协同增强、Dialog 侧滑关闭修复、TextField 改进，以及面向高级场景的 PortalHost 导出
- [Beta 12](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/releases/beta-12): InputOTP、Label、Description 组件，Popover 关闭修复，受控状态改进，圆角修复，以及变体样式属性支持
- [Beta 13](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/releases/beta-13): TextArea 组件、Button outline 变体、Tabs 改进、表单原语拆分、弹层动画重构、样式类名导出与关键问题修复
- [所有版本](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/releases): HeroUI Native 的全部更新与变更，包括新功能、问题修复与破坏性变更。
- [RC 1](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/releases/rc-1): Alert 组件、独立 Radio 组件、Select TriggerIndicator、HeroUINativeProviderRaw、disableFullWindowOverlay、styles 属性扩展、主题 surface 重构
- [RC 2](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/releases/rc-2): SearchField、ListGroup、Slider 组件，Select 多选模式，Button 反馈 API 重构，放宽对等依赖约束
- [RC 3](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/releases/rc-3): TagGroup、Menu、InputGroup 组件，Bottom Sheet Android 返回键修复，Expo 55 兼容
- [RC 4](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/releases/rc-4): SubMenu 组件、Slider Output 组合重构、PressableFeedback 水波纹修复、Bottom Sheet 返回键处理修复
- [v1.0.0](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/releases/v1-0-0): LinkButton 组件、子菜单冲突处理、可选的 @gorhom/bottom-sheet 对等依赖、ThemeColorValue 品牌类型
- [v1.0.1](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/releases/v1-0-1): Toast 竞态修复、使用 disabled 修饰符的禁用态样式、背景层样式变量 backdrop
- [v1.0.2](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/releases/v1-0-2): PressableFeedback 与 Surface 的 asChild 插槽模式、Portal 无障碍 modal 属性、Button Android 变体修复、Input 与 Select 样式微调
- [v1.0.3](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/releases/v1-0-3): 全新 Text 排版组件、ScrollShadow 反向列表支持、Tabs RTL 指示器修复、Avatar alt 属性可选化、Select 指示器统一、表单字段样式微调
- [v1.0.4](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/releases/v1-0-4): Typography 组件替代 Text、调整后的柔和前景色主题令牌与可选鲜亮配色、iOS 原生模态偏移说明、示例应用升级至 Expo 56 / React Native 0.85
- [动画](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/getting-started/animation): 为 HeroUI Native 组件添加流畅动画与过渡
- [颜色](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/getting-started/colors): HeroUI Native 的调色板与主题系统
- [组合](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/getting-started/composition): 用组件组合模式搭建灵活 UI
- [Portal](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/getting-started/portal)
- [Provider](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/getting-started/provider): 配置 HeroUI Native 的文本、动画与 Toast 等全局能力
- [样式](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/getting-started/styling): 使用 Tailwind 或 StyleSheet API 为 HeroUI Native 组件编写样式
- [主题](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/getting-started/theming): 使用 CSS 变量与全局样式定制 HeroUI Native 设计系统
- [设计原则](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/getting-started/design-principles): 指导 HeroUI Native 设计与开发的核心理念
- [快速开始](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/getting-started/quick-start): 几分钟内上手 HeroUI Native
- [Agent Skills](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/getting-started/agent-skills): 让 AI 助手使用 HeroUI Native 组件构建移动端界面
- [AGENTS.md](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/getting-started/agents-md): 将 HeroUI Native 文档下载到项目中，供 AI 编程助手引用
- [LLMs.txt](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/getting-started/llms-txt): 让 Claude、Cursor、Windsurf 等 AI 助手理解 HeroUI Native 文档
- [MCP 服务器](https://wangjinyang.github.io/heroui-v3-docs-public/cn/docs/native/getting-started/mcp-server): 在 AI 助手中直接访问 HeroUI Native 文档
